messages:
olivia_support: Hey team — customer (Acme Health) is blocked. Their rerank calls are getting 400s with a JSON validation error. They say it started after a gateway change. Full error: \"400 Bad Request: payload validation failed: 'items' is required\'.

aj_engineer: Can you paste the request payload (redact PII) and the curl they used? Also need request_id from our logs.

olivia_support: Pasted from customer (they redacted):
```json
{
  \"id\": \"req-abc-123\",
  \"candidates\": [],
  \"query\": \"best cardiology articles\"
}
```
They were calling POST /v1/rerank with Content-Type: application/json. cURL: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d @payload.json`

aj_engineer: Ok two quick notes: (1) payload is missing top-level `items` array (expected array of {id, candidates, query}) so server rejects. (2) candidates is an empty array here — even if wrapped into items it would fail our validation if candidates.length == 0.

sam_infra: I pulled ingress logs for token ending in ...9f2. Incoming Content-Type the gateway forwarded was `text/plain; charset=utf-8` in a few samples — looks like the customer gateway rewrote headers. If content-type mismatch happens, some clients send a stringified JSON body which our parser then treats as string and fails validation.

dave_prod: Request IDs from our side for that customer between 2026-02-10 14:05-14:10 UTC: req-20260210-5541, req-20260210-5542 — both returned 400 and the validation message was `items: required`. I attached the ingress raw body for req-20260210-5541: `"{\"id\":\"req-abc-123\",\"candidates\":[],\"query\":\"best cardiology articles\"}"` (note the string quoting).

olivia_support: Customer says they didn't change code, but did flip a proxy so this matches. They need a temporary workaround — can we be more explicit in the error to help them? Right now it's just a generic validation failure.

aj_engineer: Short-term: we can change the validation handler to detect \"stringified JSON\" bodies and return: `400 Bad Request: expected JSON object or array; received string — please set Content-Type: application/json or un-stringify body` — that will help. Also add explicit note when items is missing vs candidates empty. I'll open a quick PR for a targeted message and add an additional check for empty candidates arrays with message `candidates must be a non-empty array`.

sam_infra: +1. On infra side I'll add a rule to log when Content-Type forwarded != original and surface in our diagnostics page for the customer. Could be proxy rewriting.

dave_prod: For remediation we can also add a temporary shim that attempts to parse top-level string bodies as JSON (with telemetry flag) so we don't break customers while they fix proxies. But prefer explicit error first.

olivia_support: Sent instructions to customer: 1) confirm gateway preserves Content-Type, 2) ensure payload uses `items: [{...}]`, 3) don't send empty candidates — must include items[].candidates with >=1 candidate. They asked for an example; shared this minimal repro that worked for us:
```json
{
  \"items\": [
    {\"id\": \"1\", \"query\": \"best cardiology articles\", \"candidates\": [{\"id\":\"c1\",\"text\":\"paper A\"}]}
  ]
}
```

aj_engineer: Good. I'll still do the PR for improved error messages and add a unit test for stringified-body handling. ETA: a few hours.

rerank-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0021 — Customer-repro-blocker: rerank 400 due to stringified JSON / missing items. Linked to support ticket #45321.

olivia_support: Thanks all, customer is unblocked for now with the example. I'll keep this open until PR is live and I can confirm they remove the proxy rewrite. :thumbsup:
